name: Blessing of Úr [Ogham]
body:
Providing benefits to hearth and home, the heather is a staple in everyday life and the spirit of the úr ogham imbues you with the maturity and skills to match.

Prerequisite(s): Ogham Connection or the Ogham-Craobh class feature.

Benefit(s): You are considered trained in the Profession skills associated with the hearth including baker, brewer, butcher, cook, farmer, gardener, innkeeper, midwife, miller, shepherd, stable master, and woodcutter. You also gain a +1 competence bonus to any skill check involving any of those professions. If you have one or more ranks in a particular profession, you gain a additional +1 competence bonus per ogham feat you possess beyond this one (maximum of +5 granted by this feat).
